backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the backend for user profiles, conversation sessions, and access-controlled CRUD operations. Includes session management with pattern/bias/ethics tracking, role-based authorization via MixinAuthorization, and admin/user permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a single feature (updating UserManual.tsx with an AI pipeline architecture section) to its associated components and test requirement REQ-11.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, hook, and page.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.) used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the React root into a div and loading the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that sets up routing, React Query, ThemeProvider, authentication flow, profile setup modal, and language selection screen before rendering the main router.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Sticky application header displaying the Olya logo, ASR/NLP/Ethics status badges, a User Manual navigation button, a theme settings popover (Palette icon), a language selector, and a login button.
frontend/src/components/AppLanguageSelec: App UI language selector component supporting 41 languages, available in both a full-screen onboarding variant and a compact popover variant, backed by the useAppLanguagePreference hook.
frontend/src/components/BeliefStatePanel: Renders a canvas-based visualization of belief state including trust level, speaker orbit nodes, persuasion arc, and concerns overlay, plus a grid of summary stats below.
frontend/src/components/EmotionIntentPan: Displays emotion and intent confidence bars for the latest transcript entry, along with a scrollable list of recent entries with speaker badges.
frontend/src/components/EthicsBadge.tsx: Shows a compact or expandable badge indicating ethics analysis status (Clean, Bias, Toxic, or violation type) with optional drill-down into flags and bias categories.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: A searchable popover dropdown for selecting a transcript language, supporting an auto-detect option that displays the latest detected language code.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and toggling between login/logout actions via the useInternetIdentity hook.
frontend/src/components/PanelContainer.t: A reusable styled panel wrapper with a header (title, icon, status dot, optional right slot) and support for active glow variants (default teal or amber).
frontend/src/components/PatternPredictio: Displays pattern prediction results (next emotion, next intent, conversation direction, risk level) derived from transcript entries using the pattern prediction engine.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog component that prompts new users to enter an operator name to initialize their profile, calling an async `onSave` callback on form submission.
frontend/src/components/SafetyQualityPan: Displays computed safety metrics (bias incidents, flag rate, ethical violations, trust score) derived from transcript entries, with color-coded indicators and status badges.
frontend/src/components/SemanticAnalysis: Renders semantic analysis of transcript entries including emotion and intent distributions with color-coded badges, plus toxicity flag types for the latest entry.
frontend/src/components/SessionManager.t: A sidebar panel listing conversation sessions with options to create, select, and delete sessions, showing previews and timestamps for each.
frontend/src/components/SessionSummaryBa: A compact summary bar displaying key session metrics—health score, exchange count, dominant emotion, top strategy, and bias incidents—derived from transcript entries and belief state.
frontend/src/components/StrategyEnginePa: A panel that generates and displays RL-ranked negotiation strategy recommendations from transcript entries using a simulated LLaMA+RL engine, with ethics guard notices for flagged content.
frontend/src/components/ThemeSettingsPan: A settings panel component that allows users to switch between light/dark mode and select from four color themes (Ocean Teal, Midnight Slate, Ember Amber, Forest Green) using the ThemeContext.
A transcript input component with a textarea, speaker role selector, ASR engine selector (Web Speech, Whisper, DeepSpeech), and microphone toggle that submits entries with language detection.
A scrollable panel that displays transcript entries with speaker badges, detected language indicators, toxicity flags, and per-entry translation toggle buttons.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Provides a React context wrapping the useTheme hook, exposing theme state globally via ThemeProvider and useThemeContext.
frontend/src/data/languages.ts: Exports a comprehensive LANGUAGES array of language objects with ISO codes, English names, and native names covering hundreds of world languages and regional variants.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppLanguagePrefere: A singleton-based hook that persists the app's UI language preference to localStorage and broadcasts changes to all mounted hook instances via a shared listener set.
frontend/src/hooks/useAsrEnginePreferenc: A hook that reads and persists the selected ASR engine preference ('webSpeech', 'whisper', or 'deepspeech') to localStorage, defaulting to 'webSpeech'.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardState.ts: Manages the core dashboard state including transcript entries and a belief state (trust/persuasion scores, concerns) that updates based on detected emotions, intents, and toxicity flags from NLP analysis utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags for managing user identity lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useLanguagePreference: Persists and retrieves a transcription language preference (defaulting to 'auto') in localStorage, exposing get/set/clear functions via a React hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend canister operations including user profile CRUD, session creation/update/retrieval, and role assignment via the ICP actor.
Wraps the browser Web Speech API and simulates Whisper/DeepSpeech ASR engines, providing start/stop controls, interim/final result callbacks, error handling, and processing status messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages UI theme name and light/dark mode state, persisting selections to localStorage and applying them to the document root via CSS class and data attributes.
frontend/src/hooks/useTranslation.ts: Returns a translation function `t` that resolves UI string keys using the current app language preference, falling back to English when a translation is missing.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Contains a large static translation dictionary mapping UI string keys to translations across 41 supported languages, with a `getTranslation` helper that falls back to English.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for multiple themes (Ocean Teal, Midnight Slate) in both light and dark modes using OKLCH color values.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility function that merges Tailwind CSS class names using `clsx` and `tailwind-merge`.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with React Query, Internet Identity authentication provider, and the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that orchestrates session management, transcript input, and multiple analysis panels (emotion, belief state, safety, strategy, etc.) with authenticated CRUD operations for sessions.
frontend/src/pages/UserManual.tsx: A printable user manual page with a table of contents, structured sections, and reusable components (Section, StepList, InfoBox, FeatureTag) documenting all app features.
Simulates a belief graph by extracting positions and interests from transcript text and building nodes/edges representing speaker stances, trust, and persuasion levels.
frontend/src/utils/emotionIntentSimulato: Analyzes transcript text using regex pattern matching to detect emotions (anger, joy, fear, etc.) and intents (negotiating, persuading, etc.), with optional translation to English before analysis.
frontend/src/utils/ethicalConstraints.ts: Defines regex-based ethical rules for detecting and redacting harmful text patterns (personal attacks, manipulative framing, dehumanizing language, coercive pressure) and exports an `enforceEthics` function that returns a violation type and sanitized text.
frontend/src/utils/ethicsSimulator.ts: Provides pattern-based detection of toxicity, bias (gender, racial, socioeconomic, and general), returning structured `EthicsResult` objects with severity levels, flags, and bias categories for analyzing text content.
frontend/src/utils/hallucinationGuard.ts: Detects potential AI hallucinations in text by matching patterns like unsourced statistics, vague authority claims, and fabricated specifics, returning a confidence score and list of suspect phrases including context contradiction checks.
frontend/src/utils/languageDetector.ts: Client-side language detection utility that identifies languages using Unicode range checks for non-Latin scripts (Cyrillic, Arabic, CJK, Devanagari) and keyword frequency pattern matching for Latin-script languages including English, Spanish, French, German, and others.
frontend/src/utils/llamaRLEngine.ts: Implements a reinforcement-learning-inspired strategy recommendation engine that scores negotiation/dialogue strategies based on trust levels, persuasion scores, dominant emotions, and detected intents from a transcript context window.
frontend/src/utils/nlpSimulator.ts: Client-side NLP simulator that performs topic detection, entity extraction, sentiment analysis, and keyword extraction on text using keyword matching and regex patterns, returning a structured SemanticAnalysis object.
frontend/src/utils/patternPredictionEngi: Analyzes transcript entry sequences to predict next emotion/intent, assess conversation direction (escalating/de-escalating/stable), generate action window recommendations, and estimate hallucination risk.
frontend/src/utils/strategySimulator.ts: Wraps the LLaMA+RL engine to generate negotiation strategy recommendations from either raw text/intents or a list of transcript entries, with fallback strategies on error.
Client-side translation simulator using a hardcoded phrase dictionary to map common negotiation and conversation terms across multiple languages (Spanish, French, and others).
frontend/src/utils/trustworthinessScoreC: Calculates a 0–100 trustworthiness score by applying capped penalties for bias incidents, ethical violations, and hallucination flag rates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom color palette (teal, amber, navy, charcoal, panel), typography, fonts, shadows, border radii, and animation keyframes for the frontend.
project_state.json: Tracks project state version 5 for a negotiation coaching app with multi-language support, documenting architecture notes, existing features, known issues, and pending feature requests (AR-1 through AR-5+) related to AI/ML pipeline UI, translations, and manual downloads.
